Blurred for 2 seconds. Then the story's back.
Pick what you'd rather not see. Like Blood & gore.

captions.youtube_title: Blur the scene, keep the movie
captions.youtube:
Other blockers hide a whole video or channel. unscene.it blurs only the scenes you chose to avoid, like blood and gore, labels them and brings the picture back when they end. The story keeps playing.

Works on YouTube in Chrome, for videos in the unscene.it library, plus 20 free minutes of live AI a month for the rest. Free during the alpha, no account.

{link}
